preconditions.description: The number of cities is between 1 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
The number of plans is between 1 and 3 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each mineral resource label is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The cities connected by each road are numbered between 1 and n, inclusive.
No road connects a city to itself.

preconditions.expression: The given roads form a tree
preconditions.description: The cities and roads form a tree structure.
The starting city of each plan is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The destination city of each plan is between 1 and n, inclusive.
The range of mineral resource labels for each plan is between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: c_i = -1 if there is no such mineral resource that meets the required condition
postconditions.description: The output is -1 if no mineral resource meets the conditions for the given plan.

postconditions.expression: c_i is the label of the chosen mineral resource of the i-th year
postconditions.description: The output is a valid mineral resource label that meets the conditions for the given plan.

postconditions.expression: mineral resource c_i appears an odd number of times between city u_i and city v_i
postconditions.description: The chosen mineral resource must appear an odd number of times between the specified cities.
The chosen mineral resource must be within the specified range.
